caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass goblet centrally placed against a plain, light beige background. The goblet has a round base, a slender stem, and a wide bowl. The bowl is adorned with an embossed decorative pattern, including leaves and central berry-like shapes, as well as a row of raised dots running vertically along the bowl’s sides. The glass displays subtle blue-gray and white tones to illustrate its reflective and translucent qualities. There are no other objects or noticeable details in the background.
title: Goblet
